phases.name: Stable Foundation
phases.description: Account is healthy and operationally stable. GPU utilization sits at ~55%, workloads are running smoothly, and the VP Engineering champion begins exploring new AI use cases. This is the calm before the growth surge.

phases.name: Usage Acceleration
phases.description: Champion drives aggressive workload onboarding. GPU utilization surges from 62% to 78% as 3 new ML teams start training jobs. Capacity utilization crosses 80% threshold -- the expansion signal fires. Health rises as platform proves its value.

phases.name: Capacity Crunch
phases.description: GPU utilization exceeds 85%, causing resource contention and performance degradation. Training jobs queue, inference latency spikes, and teams compete for GPU time. Health drops into at-risk as the infrastructure groans under load. This is the crisis that creates urgency for expansion.

phases.name: Expansion Negotiation
phases.description: Budget secured internally. CSM works with champion and Infrastructure Director to size the expansion correctly. Negotiations on pricing, configuration, and timeline. Performance stabilizes with interim GPU scheduling optimization. Health recovers as expansion path becomes concrete.

phases.name: Expansion Close
phases.description: Expansion order signed and deployment begins. New GPU racks arrive and are commissioned. GPU utilization normalizes as capacity doubles. Health score climbs into strong-healthy territory. Champion's internal credibility soars, creating a long-term renewal anchor.
